name: asta-bench-solver-data
description: asta-bench-solver-data provides benchmark instances and solver run records for evaluating automated solvers across a variety of problem instances. It is intended to measure solver effectiveness in terms of instance coverage, runtime and solution quality and to support comparative benchmarking and solver-performance prediction. The dataset can be used to evaluate solver configurations and to train models that predict solver behavior.
reputation: Provided by AllenAI and used in academic solver-benchmarking; moderate adoption within the solver research community.
